title: WRT/WRTPOT Biomass Ownership Reconciliation and SWRD=3 Readiness
purpose: Resolve authoritative ownership of actual and potential root biomass needed by SWRD=3 without creating a root-geometry-only duplicate biomass state, and define the smallest release condition for later composition into F-WOF17.

legacy_route_constraints.meaning: Root extension based on root biomass is not an admissible simple-crop route in B1.10.

ownership_resolution.immutable_RLWTB_and_WRTMAX: shared parameter data, not dynamic state

historical_F_WOF06_reconciliation.reason: The F-WOF06 branch is historically qualified ownership evidence but diverged from the current admitted lineage; ownership semantics may be carried forward, production code must not be blindly merged.

release_condition: introduce or source-bind a current-lineage primary crop biomass owner that carries actual WRT together with the crop biomass state that scientifically owns it
expose actual WRT through a read-only biomass view rather than duplicating it in root geometry state
only allocate/persist WRTPOT or a potential biomass trajectory when the potential/reference capability is enabled
if a potential shadow is enabled across trial boundaries, prove checkpoint/trial/rollback/replay semantics
compose only actual WRT into F-WOF17 current SWRD=3 geometry; keep WRTPOT in the later root-evolution path
allowed_result_of_this_workunit: explicit production blocker for SWRD=3 until a biomass owner/view exists
forbidden: blind merge of historical F-WOF04-F-WOF10 production
simple-crop SWRD=3 admission contrary to B1.10
root growth or biomass evolution implementation
runtime or solver ownership of crop biomass
